incoming.name: Dmitri Mendeleev
incoming.excerpt: The Mendeleev crater on the Moon, as well as element number 101, the radioactive mendelevium, are named after him.

outgoing.name: Dmitri Mendeleev
outgoing.excerpt: A metallic radioactive transuranic element of the actinides, mendelevium is synthesized by bombarding einsteinium with alpha particles and was named after Dmitri Mendeleev.
